description: Architectural invariants and ruleset to maintain an unbreakable Dual-Mode (Lite/Full) and Database Switch workflow.

lite_mode.definition: A lightweight, single-process runtime designed to run with zero dependencies (no Redis, Celery, or Postgres required on first boot).
lite_mode.concurrency_limit: WEB_CONCURRENCY=1 must be enforced at startup. In-memory limiter/queue/cache do not share memory across multiple worker processes.
lite_mode.secrets_bootstrapping: Infra secrets (jwt_secret, encryption_key) are auto-generated on first-boot and persisted to <DATA_DIR>/config.json.

full_mode.definition: A production-grade, distributed runtime designed to scale with multi-process workers.

import_boundaries.rule: Direct imports of 'redis' or 'celery' are strictly prohibited inside API routers and general business modules.
import_boundaries.interface_contract: All modules must route rate-limiting, caching, and background jobs through app.state.limiter, app.state.cache, and app.state.queue.

task_dispatch.rule: Background jobs must be dispatched by task name via app.state.queue.enqueue('task_name', *args). Never call celery_task.delay() directly in business code.

uppercase_rules.convention: Connection URLs, third-party API Keys, and standard system-level environment variables remain UPPERCASE to match external tools (Alembic, Redis, Celery) and Unix conventions.

lowercase_rules.convention: Local directories, feature switches, generated secrets, and runtime-mode flags remain lowercase for internal consistency.

distributed_coordination.standalone_bootstrap: Standalone Celery worker processes must explicitly call ensure_bootstrap(get_settings()) inside celery_app.py at startup to prevent settings desynchronization races on fresh deployments.

tests.description: Executes all unit, integration, and unmocked ASGI end-to-end webhook tests.

import_linter.description: Enforces strict import boundaries on Celery/Redis.

import_guard_script.description: Checks the codebase for direct imports of forbidden libraries.
